# Using Video Editor in Kiro

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to Kiro.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.kiro/skills/video-editor/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.kiro/skills/video-editor/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness kiro --skill video-editor
node packages/cli install --harness kiro --skill video-editor --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. Kiro loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also run it explicitly by typing `/video-editor`.

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.kiro/skills/video-editor` for a project install, or `~/.kiro/skills/video-editor` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Ask the agent which skills it has loaded and check that `video-editor` is listed.

## Notes

- Workspace skills take priority over user skills with the same name.
- This skill drives the packages/videoeditor engine. Build it once with `npm run build` there, and set VIDEOEDITOR_HOME to its folder if you copied the skill folder by hand instead of using the install command. The review server binds to 127.0.0.1 by default; exposing it on the LAN or Tailscale requires an explicit --bind 0.0.0.0.
- Documentation: [Kiro](https://kiro.dev/docs/skills/) (path source: official).
